dct_description_sm: To determine the relative sensitivities to methylmercury (MeHg) exposure for arctic marine bird species based on the most sensitive life stage, embryonic development; Based on the MeHg sensitivity, predict when environmental Hg exposure levels may reach critical thresholds for reproductive impairment in the species tested;   To determine the effects of MeHg exposure on the neuro-signaling pathways of the developing avian brain using changes in neurochemical parameters (e.g. neuroreceptor concentrations) as a biomarker of Hg exposure; and relate neurochemical changes to decreased hatchability following MeHg exposure in ovo.
dct_title_s: Interspecies sensitivity of arctic marine birds to methylmercury exposure
